title: Phasmid device profile
description: One coherent device. Every value the browser reports maps to a field here. Captured data (GPU, fonts, voices, codecs, system colors) is embedded so the browser needs nothing but this file. Fields are never deleted from this schema; a field the browser stops reading is marked in `removed_fields`.

seed.description: 128-bit hex seed for every deterministic perturbation. Never re-randomized per call.

captured.description: Provenance of the embedded device data.

version.description: Marketing version, e.g. 10, 11, 24.04. Informational; the reported values are the fields below.

ua_platform_token.description: The parenthesised platform of the reduced UA, e.g. 'Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64', 'X11; Linux x86_64'.

ch_platform_version.description: Sec-CH-UA-Platform-Version, e.g. '15.0.0' (Windows 11), '' or kernel version on Linux.

device_memory.description: navigator.deviceMemory and Device-Memory header. Desktop clamp at Chromium 155 is 2 to 32; powers of two only.

physical_memory_mb.description: Real RAM the device_memory bucket is derived from. Feeds anything else that reads total memory (quota settings, jsHeapSizeLimit class).

disk_total_bytes.description: Total disk, used by storage quota calculation (hardware/storage-quota.patch); required, or quota would come from the host disk. Reported quota is mostly static on modern Chrome, but small disks still show.

js_heap_size_limit.description: performance.memory.jsHeapSizeLimit as observed on the device class.

window.description: Default top-level window geometry in CSS pixels. Inner sizes follow from outer minus the OS and browser chrome for the claimed OS.

gpu.description: One physical GPU as captured on the claimed OS and backend. Never hand-edited.

vendor_id.description: PCI vendor id of the active GPU (chrome://gpu VENDOR, a failed WebGL context's status message). Optional: when absent the browser derives it from webgl.unmasked_renderer where the format names it (the ANGLE vendor of a d3d11 or vulkan renderer, 0xffff for swiftshader), else reports 0. A d3d11 value must match the renderer.

device_id.description: PCI device id of the active GPU. Optional: derived from the (0x........) of a d3d11 or vulkan renderer, 0xffff for swiftshader, else reported as 0. A d3d11 value must match the renderer.

vendor_name.description: GPUInfo vendor_string, in brackets after chrome://gpu VENDOR. Optional: derived as empty for d3d11 (Windows identifies the adapter by LUID and keeps none), else gl_vendor (IdentifyActiveGPU).

device_name.description: GPUInfo device_string, in brackets after chrome://gpu DEVICE. Optional: derived as the DXGI adapter name in a d3d11 renderer, else gl_renderer.

driver_vendor.description: Optional on every OS: derived from gl_renderer as Chrome parses it (GLVersionInfo::ExtractDriverVendorANGLE), SwANGLE for swiftshader, else reported empty. A given value must be that parse where gl_renderer determines it; on Linux ANGLE's system info may name the driver first (Nvidia from NV-CONTROL with the same version, AMD (Brahma) or AMD (Catalyst) on an AMD GPU), which is accepted.

driver_version.description: Printed as GL_VERSION in a failed WebGL context's status message. Optional on every OS: derived from gl_renderer as Chrome parses it (the D3D11-<version> suffix on d3d11, NVIDIA <version> after an OpenGL ES version), else reported empty. A given value must be that parse where gl_renderer determines it, except with an AMD (Brahma) or AMD (Catalyst) driver_vendor.

gl_vendor.description: GPUInfo::gl_vendor as shown on chrome://gpu. Optional: derived as webgl.unmasked_vendor, which it must equal (both are ANGLE's GL_VENDOR).

gl_renderer.description: GPUInfo::gl_renderer as shown on chrome://gpu, the ANGLE string with the driver's full version. Optional: derived on d3d11 as webgl.unmasked_renderer with -<driver_version> after D3D11, on opengl with NVIDIA <driver_version> after the GL version when driver_vendor is NVIDIA, else reported as webgl.unmasked_renderer. A given value must extend webgl.unmasked_renderer that way.

gl_version.description: GPUInfo::gl_version as shown on chrome://gpu, kept as capture provenance. The browser never reads it: chrome://gpu shows the build's own string (its ANGLE hash belongs to the build), WebGL's VERSION is the fixed "OpenGL ES 2.0/3.0 Chromium" (gl_utils.cc GetServiceVersionString), and a failed context's status message prints driver_version as GL_VERSION. A page visit cannot read it.

available.description: Whether requestAdapter() resolves to an adapter.

hardware_decode.description: Which codecs decode on the GPU (MediaCapabilities powerEfficient on the main thread).

noise.description: Deterministic per-seed readback perturbation. Only for profiles whose claimed OS or GPU cannot be rasterized faithfully on the host.
Deterministic per-seed perturbation of rendered audio. Same caveat as canvas.noise.

families.description: The allowlist. Only these families resolve, via CSS, local(), and queryLocalFonts. Every family must exist in the OS font bundle.

family.description: What system-ui, caption, menu, message-box resolve to.

emoji.description: Color emoji family, e.g. Segoe UI Emoji, Noto Color Emoji.

languages.description: navigator.languages. Accept-Language is derived with Chrome's q-value algorithm.

intl_locale.description: Default Intl locale when it differs from languages[0].

accuracy.description: GeolocationCoordinates.accuracy, in metres. Wi-Fi network location is tens to about 150; IP-only is about 1000 to 100000 (stock Linux Chrome 156 on ethernet measured 75609).

geolocation.description: The position reported once a page is granted geolocation, by a provider that behaves as the claimed OS's (locale/geolocation.patch). Altitude, altitudeAccuracy, heading and speed are null. Not (0, 0), and locale.timezone must then be the position's zone, not an Etc/ zone. Absent: no position is claimed and a granted page gets POSITION_UNAVAILABLE, as from an ungoogled build.

hevc.description: canPlayType / isTypeSupported for HEVC. True only where the OS and GPU decode it.

dolby_audio.description: AC-3 / E-AC-3 support (Windows with platform decoders).

user_verifying_platform_authenticator.description: Windows Hello, Touch ID; false on Linux.

bluetooth.description: navigator.bluetooth present (Windows; absent on Linux by default).

system_colors.description: CSS system colors as rgb()/rgba() strings for the claimed OS and color scheme. Omitted means the OS default table from profiles/data.

ip_handling_policy.description: Chrome's own policy enum. 'default' is what stock Chrome does; mDNS hides host candidates already.

public_ip.description: Expected srflx address when a proxy is in use; must equal the proxy exit IP.

report_headful.description: In headless mode, report every headful value (UA token, screen, pointer, GPU, fonts).

removed_fields.description: Fields the browser no longer reads, keyed by name, valued by the version that removed them. Kept so old profiles validate.

webgl_capture.description: A WebGL context's reported surface, captured from stock Chrome on the claimed OS with this GPU. Keys of params and precision are the GL constant names used by the consistency probe.
